operation.summary: System-wide Android logcat snapshot; requires Agent Super Powers, adb grant, private build and the owner's ADB switch

query.name: buffer
query.description: all (default), main, system, crash or events

query.name: lines
query.description: 1-10000, default 1000; output capped at 2 MiB, timeout 10 seconds

operation.returns: scope, buffer, output, exit_code, truncated, timed_out, retention

buffer.description: all (default), main, system, crash or events

lines.description: 1-10000, default 1000; output capped at 2 MiB, timeout 10 seconds
